details.process: placement, approved transfer credit, or study abroad demonstrating fourth-semester Persian proficiency

all_of.source_quote: Students wishing to minor in Iranian Studies must demonstrate fourth-semester proficiency
all_of.description: Fourth-semester Persian proficiency via IRAN 250 or placement/transfer/study abroad.
all_of.note: Students who place out of IRAN 250 must take an additional elective course, reflected as a note on the Elective Courses node; threshold there not conditionally increased because the condition cannot be checked.

all_of.source_quote: All students must take one of the following courses:
all_of.description: One lower-division course: MDES 201w or MDES 213gp.

all_of.source_quote: All students must take the following course:
All students must take one of the following courses. Students may only choose IR 363
all_of.description: One course from the Iranian Studies Concentration list.
all_of.note: IR 363, MDES 375, and POSC 351 require departmental approval; cannot be checked, kept on the list.

all_of.source_quote: Students must take one course from the list below.
all_of.description: At least one elective course from the list; two required if a student places out of the language requirement.
all_of.note: Students who place out of the language requirement must take two elective courses instead of one, and IR 362, IR 363, IR 464, and POSC courses require departmental approval; these conditional/approval clauses cannot be encoded as thresholds.

details.applies_to: Political Science and International Relations majors
details.effect: MDES/IR cross-listed courses may satisfy the four unique courses (16 units) requirement outside their major department

all_of.source_quote: A special accommodation is in place for majors in the Department of Political Science
all_of.description: Special accommodation allowing MDES/IR cross-listed courses to count toward the unique-course requirement for PoliSci/IR majors.

details.applies_to: the minor (not used to meet major requirements)

all_of.source_quote: Students will still be required, however, to complete at least four courses
all_of.description: At least four courses (16 units) unique to the minor, not used for major requirements.

of_which.source_quote: A minimum of 20 units is required.
